europe_now.title: Vast German wildfire forces evacuation in Eifel forest
europe_now.summary: A vast wildfire has forced evacuations in Germany's Eifel forest. The fire has spread across large terrain, prompting emergency responses and raising concerns about environmental and public safety.

sources.headline: Vast German wildfire forces evacuation in Eifel forest

europe_now.title: EU carmakers face Nokia-style challenge from Chinese competition
europe_now.summary: EU carmakers are confronting a survival challenge analogous to Nokia's encounter with Chinese competition. An industry expert emphasizes the need for strategic shifts to sustain competitiveness.

sources.headline: [Interview] EU’s carmakers face their own Nokia challenge to survive Chinese threat, says industry expert

top_stories.title: France approves assisted dying law but rejects social media ban for under-15s
top_stories.summary: France has approved an assisted dying law while rejecting a proposed social media ban for under-15s. The decisions reflect competing priorities in healthcare reform and digital rights regulation.

sources.headline: France approves assisted dying law but rejects social media ban for under-15s

top_stories.title: Croatia wildfire injures dozens and forces evacuations
top_stories.summary: A wildfire in Croatia has injured dozens and forced thousands to evacuate. The fire has spread across significant forest areas, requiring emergency services.

sources.headline: Dozens injured and thousands evacuated in Croatia wildfire
